title: From Seattle: Private Snoqualmie Falls Tour
includes: Professional tour guide and local expert
Door-to-door service available from Seattle area hotels
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Traffic and road conditions may alter tour route
Please contact local service provider to arrange pickup from your hotel or a nearby location after you have received your confirmation.

cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Just a short drive outside the Seattle city limits takes you to one of Washington’s top tourist attractions, Snoqualmie Falls. This world-famous waterfall plunges over 270 ft down into the Snoqualmie River and has been added to the National Register of Historic Places. Join us for breathtaking views and learn more about the creation of the falls, how it helps supply power to the Puget Sound region, what the falls mean to the native people and more. Options include both Upper and Lower Observation Decks, hike (or catch a ride) to the bottom, gift shop & more.

Expect professional, courteous service and an entertaining tour. We operate clean, well-maintained vehicles featuring leather interior and comfortable seating. Our Suburban seats 5 comfortably (6 max). Includes heat & A/C, radio/CD, Auxiliary, USB port & limited rear luggage space. Special requests granted when possible.
